general_information.name: OH—RIGHT, MY NAME IS DEBORAH KWAN. THAT’S THE NAME ON MY DOCUMENTS, I THINK.
general_information.address: It’s 175 Avenue Road… in Toronto, Ontario.

current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s mostly this awful low mood that just keeps going, and I can’t seem to enjoy anything, and I’m tired all the time. It’s been… three years, I think, and even with four antidepressants and that rTMS thing it hasn’t really lifted. I keep thinking I’d be better off dead, which sounds dramatic when I say it out loud, but that’s how it’s been.
current_concerns.goals: I just want something that actually works, honestly. I want to stop feeling like a lost cause… and be around properly for my daughter.

past_psychiatric_history.assessment_details: It was in 2018, by Dr. Laura Bennett.
past_psychiatric_history.self_harm_details: It was an intentional overdose in 2018, and I needed to be admitted then. These days I do still have those passive thoughts, like thinking I’d be better off dead, but I don’t have a plan or intent, and I’m not preparing to do anything.
past_psychiatric_history.previous_therapies: Yes… CBT, I think that’s the one. It was at the hospital outpatient clinic.; Oh, the therapy… I’m blanking on the exact timing for a second. It was some time after the overdose, I think, and at the outpatient clinic, but I’d have to think a bit to pin down the year exactly. Could you ask that one again?; About 16 sessions.
past_psychiatric_history.previous_treatments: Yes — rTMS, the repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation.; In 2023.; At a hospital neuromodulation clinic.; About 30 sessions.; About three months.

personal_history.early_childhood: I was born in Hong Kong and moved to Toronto when I was 6. My family had pretty high expectations, I guess… that sort of shaped things.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: I was a strong student, but I had my first depressive episode when I was 23. It kind of… changed things after that.
personal_history.significant_relationships: I’m divorced. My marriage lasted 12 years. And… I have one adult daughter, and we’re close.
personal_history.future_goals: I want to find a treatment that lasts, and be present for my daughter.
